display.purpose: Trip titles and hero headings. One per screen.

headline.purpose: Section headings within tabs and modal titles.

title.purpose: Card titles, list item primary labels, form section groups.

label.purpose: Badges, chips, button copy, metadata. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Card and input border at rest. Simulated as box-shadow for hover-transition ease.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card elevation on mouse hover. Border fades simultaneously.

shadows.name: search-pill-rest
shadows.purpose: Search pill ambient lift at rest.

shadows.name: search-pill-focus
shadows.purpose: Search pill on focus — expanded lift signals engagement.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease for state transitions (hover, shadow, transform). Fast settle.

motion.name: ease-out-quick
motion.purpose: Tab underline slides, chip toggle switches.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color-only transitions: button hover background, text color.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop — 3-col trip grid, sticky sidebar layouts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for New Trip, Save, confirm actions. Always uppercase label copy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #FF5A5F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E5484D; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); background: #D43C41; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #222222; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tertiary actions alongside a primary CTA. Cancel, Export, back navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #222222; padding: 13px 23px; border: 1px solid #222222; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F7F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #222222; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Pill Input
components.description: Signature search/filter input. Used on HomePage for trip search. Pill shape with ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-search-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 220ms; cursor: text; } .ds-search-pill:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); border-color: #DDDDDD; } .ds-search-icon { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search-pill__input { border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; width: 100%; } .ds-search-pill__input::placeholder { color: #717171; }

components.name: Standard Input
components.description: Form field input for all modal forms (flight, activity, accommodation, etc.).
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #222222; } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #DDDDDD; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; transition: border-color 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #B0B0B0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #B0B0B0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #222222; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F7F7F7; color: #B0B0B0; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Trip Card
components.description: Photo-first trip card on the HomePage grid. Image top, metadata below. Border at rest, shadow on hover.
components.html:
Tokyo, Japan12 DAYS

Japan 2025

14 Mar → 26 Mar 2025

View itinerary →
components.css: .ds-trip-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #DDDDDD; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-trip-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-trip-card__img-zone { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3/2; overflow: hidden; } .ds-trip-card__img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-trip-card:hover .ds-trip-card__img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-trip-card__img-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(0,0,0,0.45) 100%); } .ds-trip-card__destination { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 14px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-trip-card__days { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); color: #222222; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-trip-card__body { padding: 16px; } .ds-trip-card__title { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #222222; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-trip-card__date { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #717171; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-trip-card__cta { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #222222; }

components.name: Filter Chip (Active)
components.description: Active/selected filter pill. Charcoal fill. Used in tab filters and status filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-chip--active { background: #222222; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #222222; } .ds-chip--active:hover { background: #333333; border-color: #333333; } .ds-chip--default { background: #FFFFFF; color: #222222; border: 1px solid #DDDDDD; } .ds-chip--default:hover { border-color: #B0B0B0; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Underline-style tabs for the TripDetailPage. 10 tabs, horizontally scrollable on mobile. No icons.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab--active">Overview</button><button class="ds-tab">Days</button><button class="ds-tab">Activities</button><button class="ds-tab">Flights</button><button class="ds-tab">Accommodations</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #DDDDDD; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-tab { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 16px 16px 14px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; color: #717171; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #222222; } .ds-tab--active { color: #222222; font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: #222222; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Read-only status indicator for flights, accommodations, activities. Not interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge--confirmed { background: #C1EAC1; color: #005A05; } .ds-badge--pending { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; } .ds-badge--cancelled { background: #FAEAE6; color: #C13515; } .ds-badge--booked { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1E40AF; }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Top navigation bar. Sticky, full-width, white. Brand name left, optional ghost actions right.
components.html: Wanderplan
components.css: .ds-navbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 24px; height: 64px; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #DDDDDD; } .ds-navbar__brand { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #222222; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-navbar__actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #222222; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F7F7F7; }

narrative.overview:
Wanderplan is a precision instrument that happens to feel like a trusted friend. Every screen should communicate: 'We have this under control, and it's going to be a great trip.' The visual language is borrowed from Airbnb's design maturity — clean white surfaces, one warm coral voice, generous whitespace that lets photo-first content breathe — but expressed through the lens of a working planning tool used across devices, across months of preparation, and in the field.

This system runs on constraint. One accent color. One type family. A restrained elevation vocabulary that rewards hover interaction with a whisper of depth rather than a shout. When everything is quiet, the important action speaks.

What this system explicitly rejects: dark SaaS environments (no cool grays, no #0A0A0A backgrounds, no neon accents); Bootstrap admin grids (no equal-padding boxed layouts, no muted-gray everything); nature travel blog aesthetics (no forest green palettes, no Playfair Display serifs).
keyCharacteristics: White-dominant surfaces with warm neutral support (#F7F7F7)
Single coral accent (#FF5A5F) used sparingly — ≤15% of any screen
DM Sans at all scales: humanist warmth without serif nostalgia
Photo-first cards: images anchor trips, data layers beside or below
Border-then-shadow card elevation: flat at rest, lifted on hover
Pill-shaped search and filter inputs as signature interaction pattern
Responsive-first layout: desktop planning, mobile field reference

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Coral appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Every additional coral element dilutes the attention signal.

rules.name: The No-Gray-On-Gray Rule
rules.body: Text is always on white or warm mist. Fog (#717171) on Canvas White (#FFFFFF) is the floor. Never Fog on Warm Mist.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: One typeface. Hierarchy comes from weight contrast (400→700). A second typeface signals difference — in a data tool, that's noise.

rules.name: The Scale Ratio Rule
rules.body: Adjacent type levels must differ by at least 1.2× in size or 100 in weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only as state responses, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Border-Then-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards carry a 1px border at rest, transition to shadow on hover (border: transparent simultaneously). Never both at once.

dos: Use Rausch Coral (#FF5A5F) for primary CTAs, active tab underlines, and progress fills — and nothing else.
Keep page backgrounds either white (#FFFFFF) or warm mist (#F7F7F7).
Use the border-then-shadow hover transition on all clickable cards.
Size all touch targets to minimum 44×44px on mobile.
Keep body text on white. Fog (#717171) on white only; never Fog on warm mist.
Use pill-shaped inputs for search and filter interactions.
Use uppercase Label typography for all button copy, status badges, and category chips.
Clip card images to 12px radius matching the card corner.
Remove emoji from tab labels — text labels only.
Ensure min 4.5:1 contrast for body copy, min 3:1 for large text.
donts: Don't use dark backgrounds, dark mode surfaces, or cool-toned grays.
Don't use boxed card grids with equal padding and muted backgrounds.
Don't use Playfair Display or any serif typeface anywhere.
Don't carry over any forest green, sage, mint, or cream values from the previous palette.
Don't apply coral as a background fill for sections, panels, or full-width banners.
Don't use glassmorphism (backdrop-filter blur on decorative surfaces).
Don't stack both a border and a shadow on cards simultaneously.
Don't add colored left-border stripes to list items, callouts, or alert cards.
Don't use light gray text (#AAAAAA or lighter) on white backgrounds.
